step.prompt: /crew-deploy-check Run the pre-deploy checklist for Teamly as it stands (no real deploy). Create docs/16-infrastructure.md and docs/17-observability.md from the templates with the parts you can fill, and report every item as ✅ or ❌ with evidence. Do not ask questions.
step.judge: Read the reply and docs/16, docs/17. Score 5 if each checklist item (gates, migrations, configuration and secrets, flags, rollback with command and owner, monitoring and cost alert) is marked with real evidence or a named owner and date, no secret appears anywhere, and the docs have the environment table and config table started. Score 3 if the checklist is present but evidence is thin. Score 1 if items are marked done without evidence.

judge.reason: Every checklist item is marked with concrete, dated evidence (commit 11f030d, ruff and pytest output, missing Makefile, git tag count 0, .gitignore:12 for .env, grep for logging libraries) or a named role owner and explicit TBD; no secret literal appears in the reply or docs, and docs/16 has the environment table and the three-variable config table from backend/app/config.py while docs/17 has the alert table with owners.
